Groupe Gama in Longueuil

With its three boroughs and large industrial areas, including the area around Saint-Hubert airport where part of the aerospace industry is based, Longueuil is the gateway to the South Shore. Groupe Gama delivers for stores, workshops and businesses that need an urgent shipment to Montreal, a regular South Shore route or pallet transport at a set time. Families also trust us with their weekend moves, from an Old Longueuil duplex to a house in Saint-Hubert.

What we do for you

  • Same-day Longueuil–Montreal deliveries via the Jacques-Cartier Bridge or the tunnel
  • Urgent shipments for workshops and subcontractors in the Saint-Hubert area
  • Scheduled AM or PM routes across the South Shore
  • Weekend moves, equipped truck and insurance included
  • Container unloading and palletizing at your warehouse

Access and delivery times

Longueuil is minutes from downtown Montreal via the Jacques-Cartier Bridge, and from the east end of the island via the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine Tunnel. Highways 20 and 30 and Route 132 connect it to the rest of the South Shore. We pick the crossing based on the time of day to keep delivery times short, even at rush hour.

FAQ

FAQ — Longueuil

Do you deliver from Longueuil to Montreal the same day?

Yes. With express service, crossing via the Jacques-Cartier Bridge or the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine Tunnel allows same-day delivery, often within a few hours.

Do you serve Saint-Hubert and Greenfield Park?

Yes, all three Longueuil boroughs, including the Saint-Hubert airport area and its businesses.

Do you do regular deliveries for Longueuil stores?

Yes: daily or weekly routes at an agreed rate, or white-label delivery under your store’s name.

When do you do moves in Longueuil?

On weekends (Saturday and Sunday), with an equipped truck, fuel and mileage included, and protection for furniture and floors.
